name: Cloud, Ex-SOLDIER
oracle_text:
Haste
When Cloud enters, attach up to one target Equipment you control to it.
Whenever Cloud attacks, draw a card for each equipped attacking creature you control. Then if Cloud has power 7 or greater, create two Treasure tokens.
blocked_sentences: Whenever Cloud attacks, draw a card for each equipped attacking creature you control. Then if Cloud has power 7 or greater, create two Treasure tokens.

needs.what: an effect-selector key `equipped: true` (and `false`) matching a permanent that has one or more Equipment attached to it (anybody's Equipment, 301.5 / 700.9), so "draw a card for each equipped attacking creature you control" is `draw` with amount `{"count": {"types": ["Creature"], "controller": "you", "attacking": true, "equipped": true}}` -- the Equipment twin of `enchanted_by`
needs.why_existing_wont_do: `enchanted_by` counts only Auras (`aura_controllers` filters on is_aura/bestow); `modified` also matches creatures with counters or your Auras, so it over-counts; `attached` names the source's own host; and counting Equipment with `attached_to: {attacking creature you control}` counts Equipment, not creatures, so a creature carrying two Equipment draws two cards instead of one
